name: Ring of Tripping, Improved
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 7th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

As a ring of tripping, except the ring imparts a -10 penalty to Acrobatics checks.

A remove curse, followed by cat’s grace, will allow the ring to be removed and removes the magical properties of the ring.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of jumping, improved

Identification DC 32
False Identification DC 22
